mission: Make Behavior-OS autonomy real, bounded, observable, recoverable and evidence-driven end to end.

runtimeFindings.finding: The long-lived OpenCode plugin instance serving this session is stale relative to the built source.
runtimeFindings.evidence: bos_start_mission returned: bos.transitionMission is not a function, although packages/core/dist and packages/core/src define transitionMission.
runtimeFindings.impact: Governance tool calls in the current host session cannot be trusted to exercise the latest source. A host restart is required before claiming runtime equivalence.

authorized: Inspect and harden the existing implementation without rewriting working components.
Add task contracts, real execution adapters, validated results, bounded retries, timeouts, cancellation, loop detection and escalation.
Bind orchestrated evidence to real execution and reject reported/simulated evidence where executed verification is required.
Record honest limitations and external blockers.
prohibited: commit, merge, rebase, push, tag, publish or deploy
discarding or resetting unrelated user changes
claiming a pass from simulated, skipped or mocked execution

acceptanceCriteria: The orchestrator cannot return executed without dispatching a task through a registered adapter.
A task result is schema-validated before it can affect mission state.
A task succeeds only when every required acceptance gate has a passing, non-simulated, executed check.
Mission completion in executed mode requires evidence with provenance=executed and a non-empty executionId.
Timeouts, cancellation, retry exhaustion, loop detection and unavailable adapters produce explicit outcomes.
A real shell execution path is covered by a runtime test, not only mocks.
MCP, plugin and SDK remain contract-consistent; full local gates pass.
No commit or release occurs without separate authorization.
assumptions: The uncommitted Sprint 1 tree is the intended baseline.
A shell adapter executing the current Node binary is an acceptable real execution path for local verification.
The OpenCode host cannot be restarted from inside this session; stale-host verification is an external blocker.
unknowns: Whether the configured OpenCode host will reload the plugin on the next session.
Whether a user-owned approval UI exists for escalated governance decisions.
Whether Postgres is available for live integration testing in this environment.
definitionOfFunctional: A mission plan is created, governed, dispatched to a registered execution adapter, validated against acceptance criteria, recorded as executed evidence, and only then completed; every failure path terminates or escalates explicitly and is reproducible from tests.
